reviews.t: I think it is used better as a straightener than a beach wave curling iron

reviews.t: Maybe works on thicker hair better
reviews.x: I like this waver but it doesn't work well with my hair. I have thinner hair and in order to get it to do anything to my hair I have to let it heat up for about 20 minutes, use it, wait another 20 and use it again.  Even after that the waves aren't very deep.

reviews.t: Your hair will absolutely not show up like the picture shown in the corner
reviews.x: THIS IS A WAVER, not a curler. Your hair will absolutely not show up like the picture shown in the corner. But, I do like how this makes my hair look so I won't be returning. There's just a bit of false advertising going on with this product.

reviews.t: Eh, not great with short hair
reviews.x: I really, really wanted to like this. I heard great things about these type of curling irons. It’s been a hassle curling my short hair so I bought this to help me out. Mind you my hair is shoulder length or less. It just didn’t look like the pictures some people posted. My hair just ended up looking frizzy and had a crazy, really bad perm look. Also the curls didn’t last as long as I thought. Even when I put it to the hottest it could be the curls really wouldn’t last. Maybe if I had long hair i

I expected more out of this but I was disappointed. I did like that it has a button locking mode because I kept pushing the buttons. Took me a long time to do my while head which takes less time to just use a normal curling iron and I can still get soft waves that look better. Some of the waves are falling already. Not sure I'd recommend. Giving 2 stars bc it was fast shipping and it has the locking mode for the buttons.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the waver easy to use and effective for creating beach waves, especially those who struggle with regular curling irons.
Several reviewers praise the fast heating, adjustable temperature, and durable build quality.
A notable number of reviewers report the product did not create waves or curls on their hair, with some returning it.
Some reviewers note results differ from the advertised picture, describing it as a waver rather than a curler.
A few reviewers mention performance varies by hair type, with some saying it works better on thicker hair and others saying it failed on thick hair.
